dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Observed multiple high-contrast ring-like structures in the mid-dorsal region. These features exhibit irregular, serrated outer perimeters with a sharp transition from high-intensity (white/light gray) circular borders to low-intensity (dark charcoal) interiors and surrounding pixels.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of solid, high-intensity pixel clusters without internal gradients concentrated in the anterior-lateral region. Spatial distribution becomes more fragmented and sparse moving toward the posterior and ventral edges.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A primary geometric relationship is formed by three prominent macro-annuli in the central dorsal field, creating an obtuse triangle. The centroid distances between the two superior-most annuli are roughly equivalent, while the distance to the third inferior-central annulus is 1.5 times greater.
